rules:
The first line contains the positive integer n (1 ≤ n ≤ 200 000) — the number of particles.

The second line contains n symbols "L" and "R". If the i-th symbol equals "L", then the i-th particle will move to the left, otherwise the i-th symbol equals "R" and the i-th particle will move to the right.

The third line contains the sequence of pairwise distinct even integers x1, x2, ..., xn (0 ≤ xi ≤ 109) — the coordinates of particles in the order from the left to the right. It is guaranteed that the coordinates of particles are given in the increasing order. Unique result under retained statement; 727A inverse operations have disjoint parity and determine one path. Independent audit required.
